4 اوعر بِهِ الطّرِيقُ The road became rugged to him: or brought him to a rugged land. (K, * TA.) ―
-b2- اوعر He came, or lighted, upon a rugged place. (A, K.) ―
-b3- See also 10. ―
-b4- (tropical:) His (a man's) property became little, or scanty. (K, * TA.) The man is thus likened to a rugged place without plants or herbage. (TA.) ―
-b5- اوعرهُ (tropical:) He made it (a thing, A, K,) little, or scanty. (S, A, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
